case.title: The Villa Jewel Heist
case.introduction: Eight guests arrive at Sunset Villa. They all meet in the lounge. A rare jewel is on display.
case.crime: The jewel is stolen during the night.
case.escape_plan: He will hide the jewel in a suitcase. He will leave in the car at midnight. He will use a secret tunnel.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.description: A quiet room with a desk and a safe.

rooms.name: Garden
rooms.description: A large garden with a fountain.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A busy kitchen with a big oven.

rooms.name: Gallery
rooms.description: A room with paintings and the jewel display.

characters.name: Lena Hart
characters.secret: She once stole a cheap watch.
characters.alibi: She was in the garden at 9:30 PM.

characters.name: Marco Ruiz
characters.secret: He owes money to a loan shark.
characters.alibi: He was in the kitchen at 9:45 PM.
lies: He saw a shadow in the study at 9:00 PM.

characters.name: Sofia Patel
characters.background: She is here to view a painting.
characters.secret: She is actually a police informant.
characters.goal: Get the painting for her museum.
characters.alibi: She was in the gallery at 9:20 PM.
lies: She heard the safe click at 9:10 PM.

characters.name: James "Jax" Miller
characters.background: He says he is an investor.
characters.secret: He is the thief using a fake name.
characters.alibi: He was in the study reading at 9:05 PM.
lies: He never left the study after 9:00 PM.

timeline.description: Lights dim. Jewel display is lit.
C4 sits in the study with a book.
A soft click is heard near the safe.
C3 checks the painting in the gallery.
C1 walks to the garden for fresh air.
C2 cooks dinner in the kitchen.
C4 rushes out of the study.
C4 hides the jewel in his suitcase.
Guests gather to discuss the loss.
C4 leaves the villa in a car.

evidence.name: Keycard
evidence.description: A keycard with the study lock code.

evidence.name: Fingerprint on Safe
evidence.description: A fresh fingerprint on the safe door.

evidence.name: Broken Garden Glass
evidence.description: A small piece of glass on the garden path.

evidence.name: CCTV Footage
evidence.description: Footage shows a man in a suit leaving the study.

evidence.name: Torn Fabric
evidence.description: A piece of cloth found in the kitchen.

hidden_clues: The keycard matches the study lock.
The suitcase has a hidden compartment.
red_herrings: The garden glass points to Lena but she did not touch the safe.
The torn fabric points to Marco but it is from a chef apron.

solution.reasoning: Keycard and fingerprint are on C4. CCTV shows him leaving. He had a secret plan and a hidden compartment. Fake clues point to Lena and Marco.

state.current_objective: Find out which guest is not who they say they are.

You nailed it.
